description: Convert one camt.053 or camt.054 statement (.02 or .08) to normalized JSON or CSV via POST https://checksepa.com/v1/camt/convert. JSON statements include account IBAN, balances, and entries with amount, currency, creditDebit, bookingDate, valueDate, counterpartyName, counterpartyIban, remittanceInfo, and endToEndId. A credit uses the debtor as the counterparty. A debit uses the creditor. No API key. Shares the free limit: 30 per IP per hour, 200 per UTC day, 2 MB. The file is not stored. Provide exactly one of file_path or xml. format is json (default) or csv.

file_path.description: Path to a camt XML file. Resolved by this process.

xml.description: camt XML as a string. Use this or file_path.

name: camt_convert
title: Convert camt.053 or camt.054
